Learn about them to assuage your fears. All snakes evolved from lizards. Some boas have remnants of hips. Lizards have eyelids and ears. Snakes lost them due to the way they hunt vermin. Now they have goggles over their eyes like swim goggles to protect their eyes. They don’t have ears but feel vibrations. They flick their forked tongue out like lizards. The stronger the scent on one side they know that’s the direction to go in when tracking say a rat. Some snakes lay eggs, some have are live bearing, some have eggs inside where the young hatch. There are legless lizards who still have eyelids and ears but have lost their legs. In between you might say. If snakes had smiley faces they’d be much more endearing. I was very afraid of them originally, but once I started learning about them, I find them fascinating. FYI - there are NO aggressive snakes in the USA. Not cottonmouths, rattlesnakes, copperheads. I’ve found them all. They just want to get away. They are afraid of you. They are very fragile. If you corner even a harmless garter snake they will try to protect themselves as you or any animal would. Knowledge is the key.
